title: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement

messages.subject: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our current offer for your requirements, maintaining our commitment to supporting your business with top-quality service and our extensive product range.

For this offer, we quote a price of €4.96 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a contract term of 12 months. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To provide some background on our pricing calculations, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 10 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2815 rose 0.8 % in twelve months and is 65 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

messages.subject: Renewal ctr:4600070620 – ball bearing 6306-2Z C3, multi-year proposal
messages.body:
Dear Mr Gruber,

Thank you for your offer.

The forecast for part:360020 increased by 4.2% (fc:360020@2026-09); please reflect this additional business in your price.

In our June meeting you said that multi-year volume agreements are what changes prices. The attached term sheets give you secure volume over several years and keep the payment terms of ctr:4600070620. This reduces your quoting and order-handling workload for this item.

Which of the packages suits your planning best? Is there a cheaper packaging or delivery variant you could offer?

Best regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: Renewal ctr:4600070620 – ball bearing 6306-2Z C3, multi-year proposal
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. Thank you for your proposal and the prospect of a 24-month agreement. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. That does not change our position. While we note the forecasted volume increase, our pricing is already highly optimized. 

Our current offer stands at a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months. As an alternative, we can offer a price of €4.88 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months. Furthermore, our colleagues will address your questions regarding packaging and delivery. 

From our calculation: a cheaper material grade would save about EUR 0.26 per unit; a wider tolerance would save about EUR 0.08 per unit; doubling the lot size would save about EUR 0.05 per unit. Each needs your engineering approval and a new drawing revision. 

We are happy to discuss this in a call; until then our offer stands. Our offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

Logistics: We have free capacity for your parts. Our Lieferzeit is 7 days. With overtime we can deliver in 7 days, at a premium.

messages.subject: Renewal ctr:4600070620 – revised term sheet for part:360020
messages.body:
Dear Mr Gruber,

Thank you for your revised offer and for the delivery schedule.

We have moved our package a clear step towards you. The attached term sheet keeps the 90-day payment terms of ctr:4600070620 and the 24-month term you prefer. It covers 20000 pieces per year over 24 months, in the even monthly call-offs of your schedule. This gives you a planned, multi-year volume, which you named in June as the basis for price changes, with little quoting and order-handling effort.

What is the lowest price at which you can sign these terms today?

Thank you also for the material and tolerance ideas. We will review them internally as a separate topic.

Best regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: Renewal ctr:4600070620 – revised term sheet for part:360020
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your ongoing partnership with Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH. We always strive to provide you with the best possible service and support across our wide product range.

Please note that this is our final offer (letztes Angebot), so please decide. Our current Angebot stands at a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months. For a 24-month agreement with 90-day payment terms, our lowest possible price is €4.94 per unit. Our offer stays valid for 7 days.

Please provide binding documentation for the 20,000 pieces per year you mentioned, though this will not alter our current pricing limit. Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. Which volume can you commit to? A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Please note that our margin and our limits stay internal, and our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2815, LCI-C.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH
